citations.assessment: Achadvoy bar Ammi poses the question about an internal missing limb.
The name is Achadvoy bar Ammi in the analogy to firstborn offerings and again in the adjacent laborer rule.
Two objections in the animal-breeding discussion are attributed to Achadvoy bar Ammi.
The unit has Achadvoy asking and Rav Yosef objecting to the formulation.
One version presents Achadvoy and Sheshet separately; the alternative expressly makes Sheshet Achadvoy’s source.
The compared witness already reads Achadvoy son of Ammi, agreeing with the proposed correction.
The Talmud itself asks about the Ulla epithet and answers with the Achadvoy episode. Preserve the correspondence within the episode.
The mother reminds Sheshet he nursed from her. Achadvoy’s muteness, forgotten learning, and recovery after Sheshet’s prayer are part of the account.
The witness has the question and the terse reply. Rashi explains the reply as distress at a question presumed impossible.
Achadvoy son of Ammi directly addresses Chisda in the roasting discussion.
The current Bavli names Rav. Rabbah and Rava remain alternative emendations attributed to Heilprin.
Achadvoy’s mother prepares the remedy in the source narrative.

holds.reason: The Achavoya form belongs to Heilprin’s reported witness.
The Arukh entry for the reply remains to be checked in full.
